ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows approximately 80% high-intensity (white/off-white) and 20% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit a large contiguous high-intensity zone; a thick, irregular low-intensity (black) margin borders the entire trailing edge; isolated dark-pixel clusters (mottling) are situated on the distal tips and near the peduncle attachment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a vertex angle of approximately 38 degrees; depth-to-width ratio is ~1:5 relative to the central fluke area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with frequent, irregular serrations; pixel-amplitude variations between 2 and 7 pixels; most prominent jagged peaks are located at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer trailing edges follow a convex trajectory, transitioning to a concave profile as they converge at the median notch vertex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, discrete dark-pixel clusters (rosettes) detected on the white surface, primarily concentrated near the trailing edge of the upper lobe and near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel horizontal linear disruptions (rake marks) visible on the central high-intensity region of the upper lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible minor tissue loss and irregular jaggedness at the distal-most tips of both lobes; unique black pigmentation protrusions into the white field near the peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, thick black pigmentation 'spike' extending from the trailing edge into the light-intensity field on the upper lobe's distal portion.
